verdict.rationale: The evidence documents prototype-friendly primitives: anonymous deploys, serverless functions, Blobs, and Netlify Database. Nothing documents that these same APIs carry unchanged to massive scale without rearchitecting. The only 'any scale' claim (docs-18) is about security options, which is an adjacent feature. The 'millions of users' claim (intdir-14) describes a third-party Clerk template, not Netlify's own primitives.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the same core APIs and primitives from prototype through massive scale, without rearchitecting or migrating platforms as usage grows
